notices.subject: Official Disciplinary Notice: Report of Academic Irregularity (CS302 Practical)
notices.contentBody:
Dear Rohan Sharma,

This is an official communication from the Disciplinary Office of Vignan's Institute. A formal incident report has been registered regarding an alleged procedural irregularity during the CS302 Practical Examination on 08-Sept-2026.

In accordance with Vignan Institutional Statute Sec 14(B), you are entitled to procedural due process and the Right to be Heard. You are requested to review the allegation details and submit your written response along with any supporting explanations within 5 working days.

Please log into the EduGuard Student Portal to record your receipt and submit your statement.

Sd/-
Disciplinary Office
notices.appealInfo: Appeals are governed by Statute Sec 14(B) following committee findings.

notices.subject: Procedural Notice: Hostel Code of Conduct Irregularity
notices.contentBody: Official notice regarding hostel boundary timings on 04-Sept-2026. Right to reply invoked.
notices.appealInfo: Appeals are open to the Chief Warden.

submissions.statementText: I respectfully acknowledge arriving after the designated 21:30 PM curfew. Our department robotics team had an emergency test run in the Central Instrumentation Facility that stretched unexpectedly. I had informed my department mentor Dr. Murthy via email at 21:05 PM. When security stopped me, I was distressed and forgot my wallet with ID in the lab. I apologize sincerely for my impatient tone with Guard Ramana and request that the academic context be taken into consideration.
